The Quran encourages Muslims to seek knowledge, as it is a means to attain nearness to God and to lead a virtuous and enlightened life. Additionally, the name "Issra" highlights the reformative aspect of Islam, as it calls for the continuous striving to improve one's character and actions, thus promoting personal development and moral growth.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "Issra" is a powerful reminder of the fundamental Islamic belief that the ultimate purpose of human existence is to seek and please God. This name encourages individuals to strengthen their connection with God, to yearn for His love and mercy, and to strive towards attaining His divine guidance. The name "Issra" further emphasizes the concept of 'Tawheed' (the oneness of God), as it underscores the notion that all actions, desires, and longings should ultimately be directed towards pleasing God. Thus, the name "Issra" not only encourages Muslims to remain steadfast in their faith but also to constantly refine their relationship with God, leading to a more fulfilling and spiritually rich life.
